exposure.needed: the actual size of TLS trust bundles configured in the environment and whether they previously exceeded the PEM parsing limit

original.statement: The pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes function increases its capacity to parse PEM data, enabling support for reading larger TLS trust bundles.

decision.reason: [ev-db955cc00d69] says only that pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes can now parse more PEM data, so larger TLS trust bundles can be read. It does not give the old or new limit, and it does not say which cert-manager inputs go through this function. No configuration predicate can mark which environments are exposed, so an undecidable exposure that names the trust-bundle size relative to the old parse limit is the right shape. The reason code could arguably be evidence-gap, because the limits are not stated, but the condition itself is not too broad or too narrow.
